Western Digital's Blue SN580 500GB SSD gives your computer the power of a PCIe 4.0 M.2 SSD at an affordable price. The WD Blue SN580 500GB (WDS500G3B0E) M.2 PCIe 4.0 4x NVMe SSD can propel your PC to speeds of up to 4,000 MB/s read and 3,600 MB/s write, and the number of operations per second reaches 450,000 IOPS read and 750,000 IOPS write (4 KB).

Whether you're working, creating, playing video games or processing large volumes of data, take advantage of the speed of this powerful internal drive to do more, faster. Benefit from dizzying sequential read speeds of up to 4150 MB/s (depending on model) to boost your productivity, whatever your activity.
